items.title: Explicit large lambda-adic Galois images for superelliptic Jacobians over odd-class-number cyclotomic fields
items.author: Pip Goodman
items.difficulty_reason: The global image criterion combines explicit local Newton/inertia data and transvection production with finite classical-group maximal-subgroup analysis, irreducibility/primitivity including unramified cyclotomic extensions, and endomorphism-character control. It proves containment of the full SL/SU derived groups outside the original explicit exceptional places. All original (A)/(B), polynomial coefficient/local-degree, odd-class-number, semistability and ell-bound assumptions retained. Old DU-image support is not this global large-image theorem. Exact r=3 images, full-mod-ell consequences and examples retained without extra counts.

primary.label: Complete original large lambda-adic Galois-image theorem with all local coefficients/reduction/exclusion assumptions
